remarks: LOCATION! This pristine and sun filled townhouse is in the gated Palmer Hill Association located on the Old Greenwich/Stamford townline. Enter this lovely home at the ground level complete with bedroom/den/home office and full bath. French doors lead to the private patio. The main level offers a gourmet eat-in kitchen with custom cabinets, quartz counters, SS appliances, wine/beverage cooler, and a half bath. The light-filled, open-plan living/dining room comes with a gas fireplace, sound system and custom lighting.Two bedrooms and marble bath make up the second floor. Moldings and hardwood floors are found throughout this fabulous home. Additionally, enjoy the resort like amenities of a gym, pool, business center and community/party room located at the Palmer Hill Clubhouse. Snow removal of driveway, walkway and patio included.
